name: Phinehas
bio: This Phinehas was the son of the priest Eli, who served as a priest at Shiloh alongside his brother Hophni — sharing his name, but not his character, with the earlier Phinehas, Aaron's grandson, who had been granted a covenant of peace for his zealous act against sin at Baal Peor. This Phinehas, by contrast, acted wickedly and did not know the LORD. He and his brother seized for themselves portions of the offerings that belonged to God and slept with women who gathered at the entrance to the tent of meeting, causing the people to treat the LORD's offering with contempt (1 Samuel 2:12-17, 22). A man of God came and warned Eli that his two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, would die on the same day, as a sign of the LORD's judgment on Eli's entire house (1 Samuel 2:34). The specific circumstances of this Phinehas's death would unfold in the account of Israel's war with the Philistines and the capture of the ark.
